# Retained provider values to the existing mathematical Problem

SOURCE ONLY, UNCOMPILED/UNEXECUTED. No provider, emitter, model, formula,
backend or control was run. This is an input assembly module for the existing
frontend, not proof of a physical source class or complete coverage.

Input carries explicit common original rows/menus, algebraic constants, target
alphabet, target-labelled pieces, source-independent actions and an actual
PATH budget. Common carriers remain explicit when there are zero pieces or
zero rows. Each Piece borrows an existing BoundFamilyRows and supplies a
target code plus a quantifier-free restriction in that plan's C/source scope.

prepare verifies identical positional row values/order, the SAME immutable menu
slice, outcome counts, original-ID arity, constant-prefix size and complete
model dimension. Equal masks retain different Row IDs and costs. Every retained
readout block is flattened in row/menu/outcome order. A single SourceModel
parameter bank supplies the ENTIRE vector and all later history equations.

Its domain is plan.domain AND the supplied restriction. The restriction cannot
replace the positive-power relations, strict natural gamma or other plan
constraints. It is supplied mathematical data; original S/admission/target
transport and both physical coverage directions are still proofs to provide.
Different target tags and overlapping or identical response pieces are retained,
without response-based deduplication or an assumed target function of survival.

The common menu route retains the existing concatenated-PMF restriction.
StochasticMenuChannels must match the exact menu-outcome order and derives
w*q*channel through the existing frontend. SuppliedAffine keeps its original
actual-programme correspondence obligation. Menu modes do not create extra
original forcing rows or exempt unmodelled physical costs.

The original bounded Validation code preflights source polynomials and both
domain children before cloning, accounting for the enclosing conjunction.
After assembly, the original complete validator checks the moved constants,
actions, domains, dimensions and actual budget. Descendant access reuses
existing private helpers under the [Rust visibility rules](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/visibility-and-privacy.html);
no second validator or solver engine is introduced.

Prepared keeps the original row/menu slices, every source supplier, the
assembled Problem and immutable budget. Its compile method delegates to the
existing frontend while retaining those inputs. It returns formula/query
objects only. No physical YES/NO, result authentication, backend or effective
history-relative selector is added. Construction limits propagate as UNKNOWN;
malformed supplied shapes remain Invalid. Counters are not process-wide
allocation or encrypted-writer enforcement.

Source-class global mechanism restrictions, M0, actual finite-word/phase/raw
completion/readout refinement, authorized common carrier/menu maps, two-sided
original source/target/action/PATH transport, native AST/game/QE/selector and
origin remain open. Actual native controller/recipient/sequence/transitive
first-writer admission remains UNBOUND before Cargo/Lean/native/CI execution.
No canonical profile/dispatch, new worker/local Git, owner retry or held replay.

After admission, extend the existing provider/game verification group with
different parameter arities, common C roots, duplicate-mask rows with different
channels/costs, overlapping different-target pieces, conjunction-preserving
restrictions, zero rows/pieces, menu-pointer/order mismatch, shape and capacity
refusals. These are deferred checks, not a newly run or passed suite.
